title: Motor.com - Hyundai vehicles gain access to U.S. Tesla Superchargers with complimentary NACS adapters (2025-03)
notes: Hyundai press relay: KONA Electric, IONIQ Electric, IONIQ 5, IONIQ 6 and the 2025 IONIQ 5 N get a complimentary CCS-to-NACS adapter (owners who bought by 2025-01-31); the refreshed 2025 IONIQ 5 already has Supercharger access via its built-in port.
